name: Uso x Mote ~Usonko Motemotation~
original_name: うそ×モテ ～うそんこモテモテーション～
source:
Main character moves to an academy with boys to girls ratio of 1:9. One day he meets a self-proclaimed flower fairy "Momo" who promises to make his dream come true. Without much thinking, he says he wants to be super popular with girls. That wish is granted on the condition that he can only say lies from now on.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公转入一所男女比例为1:9的学园。某天，他遇见自称花仙“桃”的女孩，对方承诺实现他的梦想。他不假思索地说，想变得非常受女孩欢迎。愿望实现的条件是：从今以后，他只能说谎。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
